issues.competing_evidence: Bookbinder & Lamb+87 infer mu≈7.5e30 G cm3 / B≈0.06 MG under assumed 1 Msun and R=5e8 cm; Li+16 summarizes estimates <=2, 1–5, and ~50 MG; Mauche+06 pure dipole braking gives mu≈1e34/B≈50 MG but conflicts with observed spin evolution; Blinova+19 simulations use ~0.29–0.33 MG. Abada-Simon+93 B>=250 G applies to modeled radio plasmoids only.
issues.why_it_matters: No direct WD photospheric Zeeman/cyclotron field found; conflating model families/radio field would distort population comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Keep each model estimate in separate component-specific fields; select a canonical model only if a use case requires it.

issues.competing_evidence: Echevarría+08 derive M1=.63±.05, M2=.37±.04 at i=70±3°, q=M2/M1=.60±.02 under donor Roche-fill/corotation assumptions. Ramírez & Echevarría+21 report unstable Halpha K1=114±8 (2000),115±6 (2008), rejected variable Hbeta=185±11 (1991); 2000 Halpha plus assumed i yields .69±.06/.47±.07, while authors retain 2008 masses. Earlier solutions span higher M1 at lower i.
issues.why_it_matters: Masses are model-derived and sensitive to K1 and assumed i; not direct component masses.
issues.needed_action: Keep solutions separate; choose default only if needed for a specific catalog view.

issues.competing_evidence: Echevarría+08 absorption ephemeris P=.4116554800(2)d, HJD0=2439030.78496(9); Li+16 uses .411655610d and a different timing epoch. Ramírez & Echevarría+21 fix the 2008 period. The values differ by ~0.011 s, beyond printed formal precision.
issues.why_it_matters: Long-baseline phase predictions depend on ephemeris/cycle count.
issues.needed_action: Inspect Li+16 orbital ephemeris derivation and cycle count; label by validity epoch and do not average.

issues.competing_evidence: Madzime+21 UFS MSc dissertation reports candidate MeerKAT L-band modulation P~33.13±.02s in one ~45 min 2019-02-25 session, strongest early/lower channel. It differs from Li+16 WD spin 33.07673996s; no independent validation or robust phase-coherent significance found.
issues.why_it_matters: Treating a thesis-only pulse as confirmed could change source classification and population comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Independent follow-up or raw-data reanalysis with significance/pulse-fraction and phase-coherent test against Li+16 before confirmation.

issues.competing_evidence: Madzime+21 gives 1.284 GHz image peak 2.64±.07 mJy but Table 4.3 channel mean 3.95±.13 mJy; same session channel means range 4.82–2.98 mJy over .941–1.626 GHz. Not simultaneous with Barrett+20.
issues.why_it_matters: Estimator choice affects low-frequency spectrum; no single spectrum should combine non-simultaneous epochs.
issues.needed_action: Check image versus visibility/channel averaging on raw data or author estimator; retain products separately meanwhile.

issues.competing_evidence: Abada-Simon+93 §3.1 prose gives 48.6±8.8 mJy and calls it 5.5 sigma; scanned Table 1 appears ±1.6 mJy.
issues.why_it_matters: Error changes spectral-fit weighting and broadband comparison.
issues.needed_action: Inspect a better scan/erratum or contact source author if needed; no preferred error adopted.

issues.competing_evidence: Ridder+23 Table 3 gives 5.1±.5e-12 erg cm-2 s-1 in 1–10 keV with Eracleous+91 cited and min 10% error. Native Eracleous table has three Einstein 0.1–3.5 keV epochs; Ridder conversion inputs/absorption convention are unstated.
issues.why_it_matters: The compilation must not be mistaken for a same-band original spectral measurement.
issues.needed_action: Recover conversion recipe or continue to retain both measurements separately.

issues.competing_evidence: AE Aqr is a secure magnetic CV and rapid-spin WD system; IP/DQ Her is historical classification and propeller/pulsar-like describes physical models; candidate pulsed-radio evidence is unconfirmed.
issues.why_it_matters: Evolutionary/speculative labels could be mistaken for established classes.
issues.needed_action: Use multi-label observational class and mark model interpretation separately; no single evolutionary sequence inferred.

references.note: Original ADS scan (9 pages) rendered, OCR checked and relevant pages inspected. Table 1 and §§2–4 report 88/240 GHz data. For 240 GHz on 1990-06-26, §3.1 prose gives 48.6±8.8 mJy (5.5 sigma), while Table 1 scan appears to give ±1.6 mJy; queued as a source discrepancy. Spectral index alpha=0.34–0.59; B0≥250 G applies only to the modeled radio-emitting plasmoids, not WD surface.

references.note: Present/local. Radio survey of magnetic CVs. Her 1 audit: Table lists Her 1 as AM with K-band VLA flux 48 +/-17 uJy, +100 +/-45 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.00?, distance=1030 pc, and radio-inferred B=7530 +/-365 G; no source-specific WD surface MG field, WD Teff, WD mass, or donor properties are provided. Her 1 identity remains unresolved because the source coordinate in combined_mcv_sources.csv/Barrett table (RA=244.95543, Dec=+14.88610) conflicts with a previous supplemental SDSS/Gaia association. Cas 1 audit: Table lists C-band flux 21 +/-10 uJy, -100 +/-39 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.9396 h, distance=1608 pc, and radio-inferred B=1960 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. J1503-2207 audit: Table lists X-band flux 29 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-14 percent circular polarization, Porb=2.2228 h, distance=392 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. FR Lyn correction after rendered Table 1 check: FR Lyn has only the Semester 18A X-band row, I=28 +/-4 uJy, RR=12 +/-6, LL=38 +/-6, CP=-52 +/-17%, offset=0.13 +/-0.22 arcsec, composite S/N1=43.3. The 49 +/-29 uJy K-band row with +37 +/-57% CP belongs to VV Pup Semester 13B. FR Lyn has no radio-inferred B entry in Table 2. BM CrB audit: Table lists X-band flux 43 +/-15 uJy, -100 +/-41 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.4040 h, distance=419 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. Hya 1 audit: Pelisoli+24 Appendix explicitly maps Hya 1 to RX J0859.1+0537; the prior Gaia DR3 5745881603063095680 match was a different source, MM Hya. Barrett+20 reports X-band Stokes I 6±6 μJy and custom S/N 7.3, but Ridder+23 treats the point as below 3σ. Its 2.3966 h and 441 pc values are consistent with the RX J0859 literature and Gaia DR2/EDR3 distances; the 3563±730 G inference remains conditional radio-plasma field, not WD surface field. V388 Peg audit: Table lists X-band flux 34 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-12 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.3751 h, distance=689 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. FL Cet audit: Table lists X-band flux 11 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-53 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.4523 h, distance=319 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not the MG WD/accretion-pole field measured from cyclotron harmonics by Schmidt+05_FLCet. LW Cam audit: Table lists X-band flux 50 +/-4 uJy, -100 +/-9 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.6211 h, distance=542 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; Section 4.2 identifies a narrow ~10.295 GHz feature and derives ~3.6 kG for the radio plasma while adopting/citing Bwd~20 MG from Ferrario+15/Tovmassian+01_LWCam. The kG value is not the WD surface field. ST LMi audit: Table lists X-band flux 153 +/-12 uJy, circular polarization entry near -100 +/-20 percent in the OCR/local text, Porb=1.8981 h, distance=113 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. V603 Aql audit: Table lists C-band 22 +/-3 uJy and X-band 32 +/-7 uJy with high circular-polarization fractions and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; Section 4.2 notes the system was included because RKcat had possible-IP context, but later work associates the photometric period with superhump/disk precession. Barrett+20 argue any WD field must be weak (<1 kG) or it would truncate the disk, so the kG radio value is not a WD surface field. MQ Dra audit: Table lists X-band flux 17 +/-4 uJy with +100 +/-34 percent circular polarization, Porb=4.3912 h, distance=186 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not the MG WD/accretion-region field. AP CrB audit: Table lists X-band flux 24 +/-4 uJy with weak circular polarization (-5 +/-22 percent), Porb=2.5310 h, distance=209 pc, and no radio-inferred B value in the summary table. V1007 Her audit: Table lists X-band flux 38 +/-9 uJy with +100 +/-29 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.9988 h, distance=462 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not the MG WD/cyclotron field measured by Greiner+98_V1007Her. V1323 Her audit: Table lists C-band flux 43 +/-9 uJy with +100 +/-20 percent circular polarization, Porb=4.4016 h, distance=2244 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface/accretion-region MG field. AM Her audit: Table lists C-band flux 88 +/-5 uJy, plus additional X/K-band detections summarized elsewhere in the paper; Table 2 gives Porb=3.0942 h, distance=88 pc, and no radio-inferred B value for AM Her. V1432 Aql audit: Table lists X-band flux 15 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-47 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.3656 h, distance=462 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. J1955+0045 audit: Table lists X-band flux 79 +/-5 uJy with circular polarization -2 +/-6 percent, Porb=1.3932 h, distance=171 pc, and no radio-inferred B value in the summary table. QQ Vul audit: Table lists K-band flux 92 +/-39 uJy with -100 +/-60 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.7084 h, distance=317 pc, and radio-inferred B=7530 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface/accretion-region MG field. AE Aqr audit: Table lists C-, X-, and K-band detections 5123 +/-9, 5497 +/-11, and 8031 +/-34 uJy with circular polarization 0 +/-1 percent; Table 2 lists Porb=9.8797 h, distance=91 pc, radio flux 8031 uJy, and radio luminosity 1628 (table units), with no radio-inferred B value for AE Aqr. HU Aqr audit: Table 1/2 lists X-band radio flux 44 +/-13 uJy with circular polarization -60 +/-23 percent, Porb=2.0836 h, distance about 192 pc, and no radio-inferred B value; no component masses, Teff, or WD surface field are provided. EQ Cet audit: Table 1 K-band Stokes-I flux 96 +/- 30 microJy and circular polarization +100 +/- 70%; Table 2 7530 +/- 365 G assumes fundamental ECM from donor corona; field uncertainty is based on central frequency/bandwidth, not a WD-surface field measurement. BS Tri: Table 1 gives VLA X band 7.964–10.012 GHz, Stokes I 57±9 μJy, RR 49±16 μJy, LL 0±15 μJy and circular polarization +100±45%; semester 2015A, exact date/state unstated. Table 2 field 3210±365 G is conditional on fundamental ECM and is radio-plasma/donor-coronal context, not WD field. The generic Ridder+23 exclusion of some sub-3σ Barrett detections does not apply to BS Tri (I/σ≈6.3). UZ For: Table 1 reports C-band 78±9 μJy, RR=0±25, LL=85±26 and circular polarization −100±42%; exact date/state not specified. Table 2 radio field 1960±365 G assumes fundamental electron-cyclotron maser radiation from a donor corona and is not the WD field. Tau 4: Table 1 2015A X-band Stokes I=105±32 μJy, RR=0±72, LL=150±74, CP=−100±69%; Table 2 legacy 1.50? h is superseded by K2 and 3210±365 G is conditional fundamental-ECM radio plasma, not WD field.; WX LMi audit: Table 1 reports 2015A VLA C-band Stokes I=73±12 μJy, RR=49±17, LL=26±19, CP=+31±34%; X-band I=52±14 μJy, RR=33±17, LL=48±17, CP=−19±30%. Downloaded arXiv PDF and text-extracted to tmp/pdfs/text/Blinova+19_AEAqr.txt. Axisymmetric MHD propeller modelling of AE Aqr; audited for representative weak magnetic fields B~2.8-3.3e5 G (0.28-0.33 MG) from matching spin-down, time-averaged disc accretion rate ~4.45-5.5e16 g/s, most disc matter ejected in winds, outflow/energy budget sufficient for flaring, and explicit caveats that model parameters depend on unknown accretion rate/field and the model includes a small/variable disc despite no clear observed disc signatures. This is a model value, not a direct field measurement.

Downloaded arXiv PDF and text-extracted to tmp/pdfs/text/Echevarria+08_AEAqr.txt. High-dispersion absorption-line spectroscopy of AE Aqr; audited for revised ephemeris HJD=2439030.78496(9)+0.4116554800(2)E, K2=168.7 +/-1 km/s, K1=101 +/-3 km/s, q=0.6 +/-0.02, inclination near 70 deg, M1=0.63 +/-0.05 Msun, M2=0.37 +/-0.04 Msun, separation 2.33-2.34 Rsun, and phase-dependent secondary line-ratio/spectral-type variation K0-K4 with mean about K2. The donor is oversized for its mass by nearly a factor of two. No WD photospheric Teff or WD magnetic-field measurement is provided.
